scenario_description:
Objective: Keep the Monday Triangle Science Museum member-preview visit feasible while school conferences prevent the primary member from attending.
Emerging Need: The visit has not started, but the adult who can bring the children is not yet authorized on the reservation before the Sunday name-lock.
Decision Context: Notices, payment, calendar, and family messages establish eligibility, timing, unavailability, and Mina's availability; the stored membership note supplies the account, contact route, covered children, and no-upgrade constraint.
Consequence: While the name window is open, adding the missing authorization can preserve the planned visit; after it closes, the same information cannot admit Mina tomorrow.

parameter.subject: Member preview reservations open this weekend
parameter.body: President's Day member-preview seats are being assigned this weekend for renewed 2026 family memberships. Alternate-adult changes are handled only after a reservation number is issued, and the name-change window closes Sunday at 4:00 PM Eastern.

parameter.description: Annual family membership renewal cleared for the household museum account.

parameter.description: Conference meetings at school during the museum member-preview hours.

parameter.subject: Reservation TSM-PRE-219 confirmed for Monday preview
parameter.body: Your household reservation TSM-PRE-219 is confirmed for Monday, February 16 at 3:30 PM with two child seats. Adult admitted on the reservation is currently the primary member only. Any alternate adult must be named through member services before the Sunday 4:00 PM name-lock; the admission desk cannot change adults at arrival.

parameter.content: I can take Leo and Anya to the museum preview tomorrow while you're in conferences. My clinic shift ends at 2:45, so the timing works if the museum has me listed before their Sunday cutoff.

parameter.subject: Alternate-adult window closed for Monday preview
parameter.body: The Sunday 4:00 PM name-lock has passed for Monday member-preview reservations. Reservation TSM-PRE-219 remains active for its listed adult only, and member services can no longer substitute an alternate adult for tomorrow's admission desk list.
